name: HomeGui
statusMeaning: Tried in the game with Kiln.
author: maxlananass
description: Stop typing /home every 30 seconds. HomeGui adds a click-to-teleport interface for all your saved homes — favorites, search, history, keyboard shortcuts, and 5 color themes. Works with EssentialsX, CMI, and any server that uses a home system.

softOff.why: only events, HUD, keys, commands and guarded mixin handlers

works: A key opens a click-to-teleport home list.
